verdict.rationale: Meltano's pricing page includes a single line claiming 'Reverse ETL included' but there is no dedicated documentation, connector list, or guide describing how modeled warehouse data is synced back into CRM/ads/support SaaS tools, and no community evidence of this being used in practice. missing for 10: dedicated reverse-ETL docs/guide, named SaaS loader connectors (CRM/ads/support), hands-on or community confirmation of reverse-ETL usage.
